principles: field-level trust rather than envelope-only trust
value-hash plus provenance-bound verification for sensitive metadata
model confidence/GWT ignition/ClayGraph salience/translator style cannot verify security fields

verify-before-commit is a useful tool-stream defense candidate
untrusted control-like content can persist through workspace writes and trigger later
privilege-separated trusted/untrusted browsing is a competing defense mechanism
